improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
improve.coach: It's come up in 38% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.
Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet. Present in 56% of matches. Keep leaning on it.
